notes.title: Bug Fix and New Tutorial
notes.notes:
I would like to start off by apologizing for how long it took to get this patch out I should have done it a long time ago. there was two game-breaking bugs that I found that are definitely fixed now.
I've also fix the bonus boss Rush not taking you back to the bonus boss Rush as well as some minor texture issues.

the game should run absolutely perfect now and I'm going to continue checking for the next couple of days to make sure there's no more bugs are issues.

now I'm done telling you about all the bugs let me tell you about everything that I added to the game.

now when you go to how to play you'll be greeted with a new screen. that has a new button for a interactable tutorial as well as a button for the old tutorial cards
as well as a white block that informs you about the F1 toggle key for changing the full screen to window and vice-versa as well as the delete key allowing you to close the game. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38654292/672e9fb825c6b255e202fb0e887ad61f3c9439c0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38654292/7875e49f290ab7bb74982611a569a045771994ab.png[/img]

also changed the mountain boss in the bonus boss content.  the mountain boss has a new design that allows you to see the money counter.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38654292/87fb49044ad167d5d1818bedf695c65f105340ec.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38654292/b628fc3e818ece3e4e139d22b336bf565a8017ac.png[/img]

I also made it so it will remember if you were on the bonus content or the standard content while you're playing the game but it does default to the normal content upon starting the game.

I've also made some changes to the code of the game to help it run better and more efficiently and give you slightly better frame rates. 

I've also added three new dialogue lines to the pp mini game for when you lose.

I also did a game Jam about a month ago and I made a small project that you can check out for free on itch.io
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38654292/bbb3400c0e19c1db1670d4b8522f4f42f41fb1f1.png[/img]

the link is here( https://non-existent-studios2.itch.io/you-want-to-hug )

notes.title: hard mode changes
notes.notes:
starting up the game you could press any key except for the Escape key
and it would switch it to hard mode but a lot of new players were continuing
to play on hard mode and would wonder why they were losing their progress
I had put an indicator in the levels as well as in the menu but it didn't seem to help.

(FIX) so I changed so it doesn't do that anymore. you have to manually switch it to hard mode now.
as well as improve the indicators.

PS I'm currently in the process of fixing achievements so hopefully in the next couple of days I'll have that fixed
